result.brief: 提出以对象为中心的潜在世界模型 RiskWorld，结合预训练预测性视频表征与 RSSM 式潜在动力学，将关系感知的对象状态推演到未来以识别自动驾驶风险对象。
result.reason: Object-centric latent world model with RSSM dynamics and pretrained predictive video representations for risk identification; contributes latent world modeling and representation use, though application is autonomous driving.
